svg.text: every call that leaves the agent, to a model or a tool
one turn of the first book’s compass chooses the call
THE KILL SWITCH CAN CUT IT ANYWHERE
The world it changes: services, people, and models
Which person, agent, and tenant stand behind the call, with what authority.
Whether rules or a person allow this call, or this change, now. Stopping turns the answer to no.
The money and quota the call may use, reserved before it goes and settled after.
Whether its effect lands exactly once, across retries, replicas, pauses, and resumes.
Evidence of what was done, for whom, with what result, kept and deleted on a schedule.
